data.title: 空门苍 · 千年御神木下的扫帚瞌睡
data.description: 空门神社参天御神木下，巨大盘根铺满青苔。本该清扫落叶的苍抱着竹扫帚靠在古树干上沉沉睡去，树叶在白衣绯袴上洒下一道道温柔光束。
data.location: mossy roots of a colossal sacred cedar tree on peaceful shrine grounds
data.action: sitting leaning against massive tree trunk, arms wrapped around bamboo broom, snoozing peacefully with head tilted and soft smile
data.lighting: 林荫筛下的丁达尔晨曦光束
data.promptProse: Ao dozes off leaning against the mossy trunk of a colossal sacred cedar, hugging her bamboo broom in the dappled forest sunlight.
data.animaCaption: Morning sunbeams through ancient cedar boughs illuminate her peaceful sleeping face.
